description: This Java class defines a REST API resource for self-service share account operations in the Fineract project. It includes endpoints for retrieving share account templates, creating new share applications, and retrieving individual share accounts, with validation and security checks.

classes.name: SelfShareAccountsApiResource
classes.description: REST API resource class for managing self-share account operations including template retrieval, creation, and fetching specific accounts.

methods.name: template
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a template for creating or managing share accounts, including client and product options.

methods.name: createAccount
methods.description: Handles POST requests to submit new share application data, validate, and create a new share account.

methods.name: retrieveShareAccount
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve details of a specific share account by ID.

methods.name: validateAppuserShareAccountMapping
methods.description: Validates if the current user has access rights to the specified share account.

methods.name: validateAppuserClientsMapping
methods.description: Validates if the current user has access rights to the specified client.
